title.sk: Butter chicken – kurča v maslovo-paradajkovej omáčke

description.sk: Marinované kurča opečené dočierna a dusené v hladkej omáčke z paradajok, masla, kešu a smotany.
description.en: Marinated chicken charred and simmered in a smooth sauce of tomatoes, butter, cashews and cream.

steps.sk: Mäso nakrájaj na kúsky veľké ako sústo. Zmiešaj ho s jogurtom, polovicou garam masaly, mletým čili, kurkumou, polovicou prelisovaného cesnaku a nastrúhaného zázvoru, citrónovou šťavou a ½ lyžičky soli a nechaj aspoň 30 minút marinovať v chladničke.
steps.en: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces. Mix with the yogurt, half the garam masala, the chilli powder, turmeric, half the crushed garlic and grated ginger, the lemon juice and ½ teaspoon of salt and marinate in the fridge for at least 30 minutes.

steps.sk: Na veľkej panvici rozohrej olej na silnom ohni a mäso opekaj po dávkach 5 minút, kým nemá miestami pripálené okraje – to nahradí tandoorovú pec. Vyber ho na tanier, ešte nemusí byť hotové.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a high heat and sear the chicken in batches for 5 minutes until charred in places, standing in for a tandoor oven. Set it aside; it need not be cooked through yet.

steps.sk: Na tej istej panvici rozpusti 30 g masla a nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu na ňom smaž 8 minút do zlatista. Pridaj zvyšný cesnak a zázvor, kešu a zvyšnú garam masalu a miešaj 1 minútu.
steps.en: Melt 30 g of the butter in the same pan and fry the finely chopped onion for 8 minutes until golden. Add the remaining garlic and ginger, the cashews and the rest of the garam masala and stir for 1 minute.

steps.sk: Pridaj paradajky, pretlak, cukor, zvyšnú soľ a 100 ml vody a var 15 minút. Omáčku rozmixuj ponorným mixérom dohladka – kešu ju zahustia a zjemnia.
steps.en: Add the tomatoes, tomato paste, sugar, remaining salt and 100 ml water and simmer for 15 minutes. Blend the sauce smooth with a stick blender; the cashews thicken and soften it.

steps.sk: Do omáčky vráť mäso, vmiešaj smotanu a var na miernom ohni 10 minút, kým kurča nemá vnútri 74 °C. Nakoniec vmiešaj zvyšné maslo. Medzitým uvar ryžu s 500 ml vody a štipkou soli pod pokrievkou 12 minút.
steps.en: Return the chicken to the sauce, stir in the cream and simmer gently for 10 minutes until the chicken reaches 74 °C inside. Finish with the remaining butter. Meanwhile, cook the rice with 500 ml water and a pinch of salt, covered, for 12 minutes.

steps.sk: Podávaj s basmati ryžou, posypané koriandrovou vňaťou. Butter chicken je ešte lepšie na druhý deň; v chladničke vydrží 3 dni a dá sa zamraziť.
steps.en: Serve with the basmati rice, scattered with coriander. Butter chicken is even better the next day; it keeps in the fridge for 3 days and freezes well.

description.sk: Vrstvy voňavej basmati ryže a marinovaného kurčaťa dovarené v pare, s mätou a opraženou cibuľou.
description.en: Layers of fragrant basmati rice and marinated chicken finished in steam, with mint and fried onions.

steps.sk: Mäso nakrájaj na veľké kusy a zmiešaj s jogurtom, prelisovaným cesnakom, nastrúhaným zázvorom, garam masalou, mletým čili, polovicou kurkumy, citrónovou šťavou, polovicou mäty a koriandra a lyžičkou soli. Nechaj aspoň 30 minút marinovať.
steps.en: Cut the chicken into large pieces and mix with the yogurt, crushed garlic, grated ginger, garam masala, chilli powder, half the turmeric, the lemon juice, half the mint and coriander and a teaspoon of salt. Marinate for at least 30 minutes.

steps.sk: Ryžu prepláchni do čírej vody a namoč ju na 30 minút. Cibuľu nakrájaj na tenké polkolieska a smaž ju v širokom hrnci na oleji na strednom ohni 15 minút, kým nie je tmavozlatá a chrumkavá. Vyber ju a olej nechaj v hrnci.
steps.en: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear and soak it for 30 minutes. Slice the onions thinly and fry them in the oil in a wide pot over a medium heat for 15 minutes until deep golden and crisp. Lift them out and leave the oil in the pot.

steps.sk: Do hrnca s olejom pridaj mäso aj s marinádou a polovicu cibule a var prikryté na miernom ohni 15 minút, kým mäso nie je takmer mäkké a omáčka hustá.
steps.en: Add the chicken with its marinade and half the onions to the oil and cook, covered, over a low heat for 15 minutes until the chicken is almost tender and the sauce thick.

steps.sk: Medzitým priveď do varu 2 litre vody so zvyšnou soľou, škoricou, bobkovými listami a klinčekmi. Vsyp scedenú ryžu a var ju 5 minút, kým nie je z dvoch tretín uvarená – zrnko sa pri stlačení zlomí, ale má tvrdý stred. Sceď ju.
steps.en: Meanwhile, bring 2 litres of water to the boil with the remaining salt, the cinnamon, bay leaves and cloves. Add the drained rice and boil for 5 minutes until two-thirds cooked: a grain breaks when pressed but still has a hard centre. Drain.

steps.sk: Ryžu rozlož na mäso, posyp zvyšnou cibuľou a bylinkami a pokvapkaj mliekom so zvyšnou kurkumou a roztopeným maslom. Hrniec pevne prikry, pod pokrievku daj alobal, a var na najmenšom ohni 25 minút – ryža sa dovarí v pare.
steps.en: Spread the rice over the chicken, scatter with the rest of the onions and herbs and drizzle with the milk mixed with the remaining turmeric and the melted butter. Seal the pot tightly with foil under the lid and cook on the lowest heat for 25 minutes; the rice finishes in the steam.

steps.sk: Nechaj ho 5 minút odpočinúť, potom biryani nabieraj až po dno, aby každá porcia mala ryžu aj mäso. Kurča má vnútri aspoň 74 °C. Podávaj s jogurtom alebo uhorkovou raitou; v chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Let it rest for 5 minutes, then scoop the biryani right from the bottom so every portion has rice and chicken. The chicken should be at least 74 °C inside. Serve with yogurt or cucumber raita; it keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

title.sk: Keema matar – mleté mäso s hráškom na indický spôsob
title.en: Keema matar: spiced minced meat with peas

description.sk: Rýchle korenisté mleté mäso s hráškom, paradajkami a zázvorom – ideálne do krabičky.
description.en: Quick spiced mince with peas, tomatoes and ginger; ideal for packed lunches.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno, paradajky na drobné kocky, cesnak prelisuj a zázvor nastrúhaj. Ryžu prepláchni a var ju so 400 ml vody a štipkou soli pod pokrievkou 12 minút.
steps.en: Finely chop the onions, dice the tomatoes small, crush the garlic and grate the ginger. Rinse the rice and cook it with 400 ml water and a pinch of salt, covered, for 12 minutes.

steps.sk: V širokej panvici rozohrej olej a cibuľu na ňom smaž na strednom ohni 8 minút do zlatista. Pridaj cesnak a zázvor a miešaj minútu.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a wide frying pan and fry the onions over a medium heat for 8 minutes until golden. Add the garlic and ginger and stir for a minute.

steps.sk: Pridaj mäso a opekaj ho 6 minút na silnejšom ohni, hrudky rozbíjaj vareškou. Keď sa šťava odparí a mäso zbelie, vmiešaj všetky mleté koreniny okrem garam masaly a miešaj 1 minútu.
steps.en: Add the mince and fry over a fairly high heat for 6 minutes, breaking up the lumps with a wooden spoon. When the juices have evaporated and the meat has turned pale, stir in all the ground spices except the garam masala for 1 minute.

steps.sk: Pridaj paradajky, soľ a 150 ml vody a var prikryté 10 minút. Potom pridaj hrášok a garam masalu a var odkryté 5 minút, kým zmes nie je hustá a hrášok mäkký. Mäso je hotové pri 74 °C.
steps.en: Add the tomatoes, salt and 150 ml water and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes. Then add the peas and garam masala and cook uncovered for 5 minutes until thick and the peas are tender. The meat is done at 74 °C.

steps.sk: Posyp koriandrovou vňaťou a podávaj s ryžou, chlebom alebo v pite. Keema vydrží v chladničke 4 dni a dobre sa mrazí.
steps.en: Scatter with coriander and serve with rice, bread or in a pitta. Keema keeps in the fridge for 4 days and freezes well.

description.sk: Vajcia natvrdo opečené s kurkumou a dusené v cibuľovo-paradajkovej omáčke s kokosovým mliekom.
description.en: Hard-boiled eggs fried with turmeric and simmered in an onion and tomato sauce with coconut milk.

steps.sk: Vajcia var 9 minút natvrdo, ponor ich do studenej vody a ošúp. Nožom ich na štyroch miestach plytko narež, aby do nich vsiakla omáčka. Ryžu prepláchni a var so 500 ml vody a štipkou soli pod pokrievkou 12 minút.
steps.en: Hard-boil the eggs for 9 minutes, plunge them into cold water and peel. Make four shallow slits in each so the sauce can soak in. Rinse the rice and cook it with 500 ml water and a pinch of salt, covered, for 12 minutes.

steps.sk: V panvici rozohrej olej, pridaj ¼ lyžičky kurkumy a vajcia na ňom opekaj 2 minúty za obracania, kým nemajú zlatistú kôrku. Vyber ich.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a frying pan, add ¼ teaspoon of the turmeric and fry the eggs for 2 minutes, turning, until they have a golden skin. Lift them out.

steps.sk: Na tom istom oleji smaž nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu 10 minút do zlatohneda, pridaj prelisovaný cesnak a nastrúhaný zázvor a po minúte všetky mleté koreniny okrem garam masaly. Miešaj 30 sekúnd, aby sa nepripálili.
steps.en: In the same oil, fry the finely chopped onions for 10 minutes until golden brown, add the crushed garlic and grated ginger and after a minute all the ground spices except the garam masala. Stir for 30 seconds so they do not burn.

steps.sk: Pridaj paradajky a soľ a var 8 minút, kým na okrajoch nezačne vystupovať olej – to je znak, že je základ omáčky hotový. Vmiešaj kokosové mlieko a garam masalu, vlož vajcia a var 5 minút.
steps.en: Add the tomatoes and salt and simmer for 8 minutes until the oil starts to separate at the edges, a sign the sauce base is ready. Stir in the coconut milk and garam masala, add the eggs and simmer for 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Posyp koriandrovou vňaťou a podávaj s ryžou. Je to rýchle a lacné kari; omáčka bez vajec vydrží v chladničke 3 dni, vajcia do nej pridávaj čerstvo uvarené.
steps.en: Scatter with coriander and serve with the rice. It is a quick, cheap curry; the sauce without eggs keeps in the fridge for 3 days, with freshly boiled eggs added when serving.

title.sk: Dal makhani – krémová šošovica s fazuľou
title.en: Dal makhani: creamy lentils and kidney beans

description.sk: Pomaly varená šošovica s červenou fazuľou v paradajkovej omáčke s maslom a smotanou.
description.en: Slow-cooked lentils and kidney beans in a tomato sauce enriched with butter and cream.

steps.sk: Šošovicu prepláchni, zalej ju 1,2 litra vody a var prikrytú 35 až 40 minút, kým nie je úplne mäkká a nezačína sa rozpadávať. Pridaj scedenú fazuľu a lyžičku soli.
steps.en: Rinse the lentils, cover with 1.2 litres of water and simmer, covered, for 35 to 40 minutes until completely soft and starting to break down. Add the drained beans and a teaspoon of salt.

steps.sk: Medzitým rozpusti na panvici polovicu masla a smaž na ňom nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu 8 minút. Pridaj prelisovaný cesnak, nastrúhaný zázvor, rímsky kmín a čili, po minúte paradajky s pretlakom a var 10 minút do hustej omáčky.
steps.en: Meanwhile, melt half the butter in a frying pan and fry the finely chopped onion for 8 minutes. Add the crushed garlic, grated ginger, cumin and chilli, then after a minute the tomatoes and paste, and simmer for 10 minutes into a thick sauce.

steps.sk: Omáčku vmiešaj do šošovice a var na najmenšom ohni ďalších 20 minút, často miešaj až po dno. Časť šošovice roztlač vareškou o stenu hrnca, dal bude krémový.
steps.en: Stir the sauce into the lentils and simmer on the lowest heat for another 20 minutes, stirring often right to the bottom. Mash some of the lentils against the side of the pot with a wooden spoon to make the dal creamy.

steps.sk: Ryžu prepláchni a var so 600 ml vody a štipkou soli pod pokrievkou 12 minút. Do dalu vmiešaj zvyšné maslo, smotanu a garam masalu a dochuť zvyšnou soľou.
steps.en: Rinse the rice and cook it with 600 ml water and a pinch of salt, covered, for 12 minutes. Stir the remaining butter, the cream and the garam masala into the dal and season with the rest of the salt.

steps.sk: Podávaj s ryžou alebo chlebom, posypané koriandrovou vňaťou a s kvapkou smotany navrchu. Dal makhani je ešte lepší na druhý deň; v chladničke vydrží 4 dni a dobre sa mrazí.
steps.en: Serve with the rice or bread, scattered with coriander and a swirl of cream. Dal makhani is even better the next day; it keeps in the fridge for 4 days and freezes well.

title.sk: Baingan bharta – údený baklažán s paradajkami
title.en: Baingan bharta: smoky mashed aubergine curry

description.sk: Baklažány opečené pod grilom do čierna, roztlačené s cibuľou, paradajkami a korením.
description.en: Aubergines charred under the grill and mashed with onion, tomatoes and spices.

steps.sk: Rúru zapni na gril na najvyšší stupeň. Baklažány na niekoľkých miestach prepichni vidličkou, polož ich na plech tesne pod gril a peč 30 až 35 minút, každých 10 minút ich otoč. Šupka má byť zuhoľnatená a dužina mäkká ako kaša – to dá jedlu údenú chuť.
steps.en: Turn the oven grill to its highest setting. Prick the aubergines in a few places, set them on a tray just below the grill and cook for 30 to 35 minutes, turning every 10 minutes. The skin should be charred black and the flesh as soft as mash, which gives the dish its smoky flavour.

steps.sk: Baklažány nechaj 10 minút vychladnúť prikryté v miske, potom z nich stiahni spálenú šupku a dužinu nasekaj nožom na hrubú kašu. Ryžu prepláchni a var so 500 ml vody a štipkou soli 12 minút.
steps.en: Cover the aubergines in a bowl and let them cool for 10 minutes, then peel off the charred skin and chop the flesh into a coarse mash. Rinse the rice and cook it with 500 ml water and a pinch of salt for 12 minutes.

steps.sk: Na panvici rozohrej olej a smaž na ňom rímsky kmín 30 sekúnd, kým nezavonia, potom pridaj nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu a opekaj 6 minút. Pridaj cesnak, zázvor, nasekané čili, kurkumu a koriander a miešaj minútu.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the cumin for 30 seconds until fragrant, then add the finely chopped onion and cook for 6 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger, chopped chilli, turmeric and coriander and stir for a minute.

steps.sk: Pridaj nakrájané paradajky a soľ a var 6 minút, kým sa nerozpadnú. Vmiešaj baklažán a hrášok a var ďalších 8 minút za častého miešania, aby sa chute spojili. Nakoniec pridaj garam masalu.
steps.en: Add the chopped tomatoes and salt and cook for 6 minutes until they break down. Stir in the aubergine and peas and cook for another 8 minutes, stirring often, so the flavours meld. Finish with the garam masala.

steps.sk: Posyp koriandrovou vňaťou a podávaj s ryžou alebo plackami. Bharta vydrží v chladničke 3 dni a chutí aj vlažná.
steps.en: Scatter with coriander and serve with the rice or flatbreads. Bharta keeps in the fridge for 3 days and is good lukewarm too.

description.sk: Jemné krémové kari zo zeleniny v omáčke z kešu orechov a kokosového mlieka.
description.en: A mild, creamy curry of vegetables in a cashew and coconut milk sauce.

steps.sk: Kešu zalej 150 ml horúcej vody a nechaj 15 minút namočené. Karfiol rozober na ružičky, zemiaky a mrkvu nakrájaj na kocky s hranou 2 cm a fazuľky na 3 cm kúsky.
steps.en: Soak the cashews in 150 ml hot water for 15 minutes. Break the cauliflower into florets, cut the potatoes and carrots into 2 cm cubes and the green beans into 3 cm lengths.

steps.sk: Kešu aj s vodou rozmixuj s cesnakom a zázvorom na hladkú pastu. Ryžu prepláchni a var so 500 ml vody a štipkou soli pod pokrievkou 12 minút.
steps.en: Blend the cashews and their water with the garlic and ginger into a smooth paste. Rinse the rice and cook it with 500 ml water and a pinch of salt, covered, for 12 minutes.

steps.sk: Vo veľkom hrnci rozohrej olej, smaž na ňom nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu 6 minút do zlatista, potom pridaj kešu pastu a mleté koreniny a miešaj 2 minúty, kým nezačne voňať a hustnúť.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a large pot and fry the finely chopped onion for 6 minutes until golden, then add the cashew paste and ground spices and stir for 2 minutes until fragrant and thickened.

steps.sk: Pridaj zemiaky, mrkvu, karfiol, kokosové mlieko, 200 ml vody a soľ a var prikryté 15 minút. Potom pridaj fazuľky a hrášok a var ďalších 5 minút, kým nie je všetka zelenina mäkká.
steps.en: Add the potatoes, carrots, cauliflower, coconut milk, 200 ml water and the salt and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes. Then add the green beans and peas and cook for 5 more minutes until all the vegetables are tender.

steps.sk: Korma má byť jemná, krémová a len mierne korenistá. Posyp ju koriandrovou vňaťou a podávaj s ryžou. V chladničke vydrží 3 dni; pri ohrievaní prilej trochu vody.
steps.en: The korma should be mild, creamy and only gently spiced. Scatter with coriander and serve with the rice. It keeps in the fridge for 3 days; add a little water when reheating.

title.sk: Pav bhaji – korenistá zeleninová kaša so žemľami
title.en: Pav bhaji: spiced vegetable mash with buttered buns

description.sk: Pouličné jedlo z Mumbaja: maslová korenistá zeleninová kaša s opečenými žemľami na namáčanie.
description.en: Mumbai street food: a buttery spiced vegetable mash with toasted buns for dipping.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp a nakrájaj, karfiol rozober na ružičky a var ich spolu s hráškom v osolenej vode (½ lyžičky soli) 15 minút do mäkka. Sceď ich a nahrubo roztlač.
steps.en: Peel and chop the potatoes, break the cauliflower into florets and boil them with the peas in salted water (½ teaspoon of salt) for 15 minutes until tender. Drain and roughly mash.

steps.sk: Jednu cibuľu, papriku a paradajky nakrájaj nadrobno; druhú cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno na podávanie. Na širokej panvici rozpusti 30 g masla a smaž na ňom cibuľu 5 minút, pridaj papriku, cesnak a zázvor a opekaj 3 minúty.
steps.en: Finely chop one onion, the pepper and the tomatoes; finely chop the second onion for serving. Melt 30 g of the butter in a wide pan and fry the onion for 5 minutes, then add the pepper, garlic and ginger and cook for 3 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj paradajky, kari, garam masalu, čili a zvyšnú soľ a var 5 minút, kým sa paradajky nerozpadnú. Pridaj roztlačenú zeleninu a 150 ml vody a roztláčaj ju priamo v panvici, kým nevznikne hustá, hladká kaša. Var ešte 5 minút.
steps.en: Add the tomatoes, curry powder, garam masala, chilli powder and remaining salt and cook for 5 minutes until the tomatoes collapse. Add the mashed vegetables and 150 ml water and mash everything together in the pan into a thick, smooth purée. Cook for 5 more minutes.

steps.sk: Žemle rozkroj, potri ich zvyšným maslom a opeč na suchej panvici reznou plochou nadol 1 až 2 minúty dozlatista.
steps.en: Split the buns, spread them with the remaining butter and toast them cut side down in a dry pan for 1 to 2 minutes until golden.

steps.sk: Bhaji posyp nakrájanou cibuľou a koriandrovou vňaťou, pokvapkaj citrónom a podávaj s teplými žemľami na namáčanie. Kaša vydrží v chladničke 3 dni.
steps.en: Top the bhaji with the chopped onion and coriander, squeeze over some lemon and serve with the warm buns for dipping. The mash keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

title.sk: Goanské rybacie kari s kokosovým mliekom
title.en: Goan fish curry with coconut milk

description.sk: Biela ryba v kyslastej kokosovej omáčke s paradajkami, zázvorom a čili, s basmati ryžou.
description.en: White fish in a tangy coconut sauce with tomatoes, ginger and chilli, with basmati rice.

steps.sk: Rybu nakrájaj na kusy s hranou 4 cm, posoľ ju ¼ lyžičky soli a premiešaj s kurkumou. Ryžu prepláchni a var so 500 ml vody a štipkou soli pod pokrievkou 12 minút.
steps.en: Cut the fish into 4 cm pieces, season with ¼ teaspoon of salt and toss with the turmeric. Rinse the rice and cook it with 500 ml water and a pinch of salt, covered, for 12 minutes.

steps.sk: V širokej panvici rozohrej olej a cibuľu nakrájanú na tenké polkolieska na ňom smaž 6 minút do zlatista. Pridaj cesnak, zázvor a nasekanú čili papričku a po minúte koriander, rímsky kmín a mleté čili.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a wide frying pan and fry the thinly sliced onion for 6 minutes until golden. Add the garlic, ginger and chopped chilli and after a minute the coriander, cumin and chilli powder.

steps.sk: Pridaj nakrájané paradajky a var 5 minút, kým nezmäknú. Prilej kokosové mlieko, ocot a zvyšnú soľ a var 5 minút, kým omáčka mierne nezhustne.
steps.en: Add the chopped tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes until soft. Pour in the coconut milk, vinegar and remaining salt and simmer for 5 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly.

steps.sk: Kusy ryby vlož do omáčky, aby boli ponorené, a var na miernom ohni 5 až 6 minút bez miešania – panvicou len jemne zatras. Ryba je hotová, keď je biela a rozpadá sa na lupienky.
steps.en: Slip the fish into the sauce so it is submerged and simmer gently for 5 to 6 minutes without stirring; just shake the pan gently. The fish is done when white and flaking.

steps.sk: Posyp koriandrovou vňaťou a podávaj s ryžou. Kari je najlepšie čerstvé; omáčku môžeš pripraviť deň vopred a rybu v nej uvariť až pred jedlom.
steps.en: Scatter with coriander and serve with the rice. The curry is best fresh; you can make the sauce a day ahead and cook the fish in it just before eating.

title.sk: Khichdi – ryža so šošovicou a zeleninou
title.en: Khichdi: rice and lentil porridge with vegetables

description.sk: Jemná indická kaša z ryže a červenej šošovice s rímskym kmínom, kurkumou a zeleninou.
description.en: A gentle Indian porridge of rice and red lentils with cumin, turmeric and vegetables.

steps.sk: Ryžu a šošovicu spolu prepláchni v sitku, kým voda nie je takmer číra. Cibuľu a paradajku nakrájaj nadrobno, mrkvu na drobné kocky, cesnak prelisuj a zázvor nastrúhaj.
steps.en: Rinse the rice and lentils together in a sieve until the water runs almost clear. Finely chop the onion and tomato, dice the carrot small, crush the garlic and grate the ginger.

steps.sk: V hrnci rozohrej olej, pridaj rímsky kmín a smaž ho 30 sekúnd, kým nezačne praskať. Pridaj cibuľu a opekaj 5 minút, potom cesnak, zázvor, kurkumu a paradajku a miešaj 2 minúty.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a pot, add the cumin and fry for 30 seconds until it crackles. Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes, then the garlic, ginger, turmeric and tomato and stir for 2 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj ryžu so šošovicou, mrkvu, soľ a 1,2 litra vody, priveď do varu a var prikryté na miernom ohni 20 minút, občas premiešaj až po dno. Posledných 5 minút pridaj hrášok.
steps.en: Add the rice and lentils, carrot, salt and 1.2 litres of water, bring to the boil and simmer, covered, over a low heat for 20 minutes, stirring right to the bottom now and then. Add the peas for the last 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Khichdi má mať konzistenciu hustej kaše; ak je príliš husté, prilej horúcu vodu. Vmiešaj garam masalu a nechaj 5 minút odpočinúť.
steps.en: Khichdi should be the consistency of a thick porridge; add hot water if it is too stiff. Stir in the garam masala and let it rest for 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Podávaj posypané koriandrovou vňaťou s mesiačikom citróna. V Indii je to ľahké jedlo na dni, keď telo potrebuje oddych; v chladničke vydrží 3 dni a pri ohrievaní prilej vodu.
steps.en: Serve scattered with coriander, with a lemon wedge. In India it is the light dish for days when the body needs a rest; it keeps in the fridge for 3 days, with water added when reheating.

title.sk: Tandoori kuracie stehná z rúry s raitou
title.en: Oven tandoori chicken thighs with cucumber raita

description.sk: Stehná marinované v jogurte s korením, upečené v horúcej rúre do pripálenia, s mätovou raitou.
description.en: Thighs marinated in spiced yogurt and roasted in a hot oven until charred, with mint raita.

steps.sk: Stehná na niekoľkých miestach hlboko narež. Zmiešaj 150 g jogurtu s citrónovou šťavou, prelisovaným cesnakom, nastrúhaným zázvorom, všetkými koreninami, olejom a ¾ lyžičky soli a mäso v marináde dôkladne obaľ. Nechaj ho v chladničke marinovať aspoň 1 hodinu, najlepšie cez noc.
steps.en: Cut a few deep slashes into each thigh. Mix 150 g of the yogurt with the lemon juice, crushed garlic, grated ginger, all the spices, the oil and ¾ teaspoon of salt and coat the chicken thoroughly. Marinate in the fridge for at least 1 hour, ideally overnight.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 230 °C. Stehná rozlož na mriežku nad plechom s alobalom, aby šťava odkvapkávala a mäso sa zospodu nedusilo. Ryžu prepláchni a var so 500 ml vody a štipkou soli pod pokrievkou 12 minút.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 230 °C. Lay the thighs on a rack over a foil-lined tray so the juices drip away and the chicken does not steam underneath. Rinse the rice and cook it with 500 ml water and a pinch of salt, covered, for 12 minutes.

steps.sk: Peč 25 až 30 minút, kým okraje nie sú tmavé a miestami pripálené – tak chutí tandoor. Mäso je hotové pri 74 °C, keď z neho vyteká číra šťava.
steps.en: Roast for 25 to 30 minutes until the edges are dark and charred in places, the way a tandoor tastes. The chicken is done at 74 °C, when the juices run clear.

steps.sk: Na raitu uhorku nastrúhaj, vytlač a zmiešaj so zvyšným jogurtom, nasekanou mätou a štipkou soli. Červenú cibuľu nakrájaj na tenké kolieska.
steps.en: For the raita, grate and squeeze the cucumber and mix it with the remaining yogurt, chopped mint and a pinch of salt. Slice the red onion into thin rings.

steps.sk: Podávaj stehná s ryžou, raitou a cibuľou. Upečené vydržia v chladničke 3 dni a výborne chutia aj studené v šaláte alebo zábale.
steps.en: Serve the thighs with the rice, raita and onion. Once roasted they keep in the fridge for 3 days and are great cold in a salad or wrap.

description.sk: Opečené šampiňóny a hrášok v korenistej paradajkovej omáčke s kúskom kokosového mlieka.
description.en: Browned mushrooms and peas in a spiced tomato sauce with a splash of coconut milk.

steps.sk: Huby očisti a nakrájaj na štvrtinky, cibuľu nadrobno, cesnak prelisuj a zázvor nastrúhaj. Ryžu prepláchni a var so 500 ml vody a štipkou soli pod pokrievkou 12 minút.
steps.en: Clean and quarter the mushrooms, chop the onions finely, crush the garlic and grate the ginger. Rinse the rice and cook it with 500 ml water and a pinch of salt, covered, for 12 minutes.

steps.sk: Na veľkej panvici rozohrej lyžicu oleja a huby opekaj na silnom ohni 6 minút, kým sa šťava neodparí a nezhnednú. Vyber ich.
steps.en: Heat a tablespoon of oil in a large frying pan and fry the mushrooms over a high heat for 6 minutes until their juices evaporate and they brown. Lift them out.

steps.sk: Na zvyšnom oleji smaž cibuľu 8 minút do zlatohneda, pridaj cesnak, zázvor a rímsky kmín a po minúte koriander, kurkumu a čili. Miešaj 30 sekúnd, kým koreniny nezavoňajú.
steps.en: Fry the onions in the remaining oil for 8 minutes until golden brown, add the garlic, ginger and cumin and after a minute the coriander, turmeric and chilli. Stir for 30 seconds until the spices smell fragrant.

steps.sk: Pridaj paradajky a soľ a var 8 minút do hustej omáčky. Vráť huby, pridaj hrášok a kokosové mlieko a var ďalších 5 minút. Nakoniec vmiešaj garam masalu.
steps.en: Add the tomatoes and salt and simmer for 8 minutes into a thick sauce. Return the mushrooms, add the peas and coconut milk and simmer for 5 more minutes. Finish with the garam masala.

steps.sk: Posyp koriandrovou vňaťou a podávaj s ryžou alebo plackami. Kari vydrží v chladničke 3 dni a na druhý deň chutí ešte výraznejšie.
steps.en: Scatter with coriander and serve with the rice or flatbreads. The curry keeps in the fridge for 3 days and tastes even bolder the next day.

description.sk: Rýchle suchšie kari z kuracích pŕs s chrumkavou paprikou, cibuľou a čerstvým čili.
description.en: A quick, drier curry of chicken breast with crunchy peppers, onion and fresh chilli.

steps.sk: Mäso nakrájaj na kocky s hranou 2,5 cm a zmiešaj s kurkumou, polovicou rímskeho kmínu a ½ lyžičky soli. Papriky a jednu cibuľu nakrájaj na veľké štvorce (3 cm), druhú cibuľu nadrobno a čili na kolieska. Ryžu daj variť so 500 ml vody a štipkou soli na 12 minút.
steps.en: Cut the chicken into 2.5 cm cubes and toss with the turmeric, half the cumin and ½ teaspoon of salt. Cut the peppers and one onion into large 3 cm squares, chop the second onion finely and slice the chillies. Put the rice on to cook with 500 ml water and a pinch of salt for 12 minutes.

steps.sk: Vo woku alebo veľkej panvici rozohrej 2 lyžice oleja na silnom ohni a mäso opekaj 5 minút, kým nie je zo všetkých strán zlatisté. Vyber ho na tanier.
steps.en: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a wok or large frying pan over a high heat and fry the chicken for 5 minutes until golden on all sides. Set it aside on a plate.

steps.sk: Na zvyšnom oleji smaž nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu 5 minút, pridaj cesnak, zázvor, zvyšný kmín, koriander a pretlak a miešaj 1 minútu. Pridaj nakrájané paradajky a zvyšnú soľ a var 5 minút do hustej omáčky.
steps.en: Fry the finely chopped onion in the remaining oil for 5 minutes, add the garlic, ginger, remaining cumin, the coriander and tomato paste and stir for 1 minute. Add the chopped tomatoes and remaining salt and cook for 5 minutes into a thick sauce.

steps.sk: Vráť mäso, pridaj papriky, cibuľové štvorce a čili a na silnom ohni opekaj 5 až 6 minút, kým zelenina zmäkne, ale zostane chrumkavá. Kurča je hotové pri 74 °C. Nakoniec vmiešaj garam masalu.
steps.en: Return the chicken, add the peppers, onion squares and chilli and stir-fry over a high heat for 5 to 6 minutes until the vegetables soften but keep their crunch. The chicken is done at 74 °C. Finish with the garam masala.

steps.sk: Posyp koriandrovou vňaťou a podávaj s ryžou. Jalfrezi je suchšie kari, preto sa hodí do krabičky – v chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Scatter with coriander and serve with the rice. Jalfrezi is a drier curry, so it travels well in a lunch box; it keeps in the fridge for 3 days.
